name: Ice Cubes (arm64, three agents, real tasks)
description: https://github.com/Dimillian/IceCubesApp. Three agents at the same time, each with a small task defined in advance and judged by a build and the package's own tests: a public helper added to Models (12 packages depend on it), a computed property added to Timeline's filter enum, a helper added to Env (most feature packages depend on it). Each task first writes code that does not compile (a typo, a non-exhaustive switch, an optional not unwrapped), fixes it, adds a unit test, runs the package's tests and builds the app. Plain: git worktree + the README's setup, xcodebuild into the default DerivedData, tests on the simulator named in the command (as an agent would write it). xcfs: slots warmed first (the warm-up is timed and reported), xcfs check / build / test (each checkout its own simulator). One architecture (ARCHS=arm64).

create: cd {dest} && cp IceCubesApp.xcconfig.template IceCubesApp.xcconfig && sed -i '' 's/^DEVELOPMENT_TEAM = .*/DEVELOPMENT_TEAM =/' IceCubesApp.xcconfig
plain.build: xcodebuild build -project IceCubesApp.xcodeproj -scheme IceCubesApp -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO ARCHS=arm64
plain.test: xcodebuild test -project IceCubesApp.xcodeproj -scheme {scheme} -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 18 Pro' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO ARCHS=arm64
plain.check: xcodebuild build -project IceCubesApp.xcodeproj -scheme {scheme} -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO ARCHS=arm64
